thag4.6:1.1: Svāgataṃ vata me āsi Gayāyaṃ Gayaphagguyā yaṃ addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ desentaṃ dhammam uttamaṃ || ||
thag4.6:2.1: mahappabhaṃ gaṇācariyaṃ aggapattaṃ vināyakaṃ sadevakassa lokassa jinaṃ atuladassanaṃ || ||
thag4.6:3.1: mahānāgaṃ mahāvīraṃ mahājutim anāsavaṃ sabbāsavaparikkhīṇaṃ satthāram akutobhayaṃ. || ||
thag4.6:4.1: cirasaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ vata maṃ diṭṭhisandānasanditaṃ vimocayī so bhagavā sabbaganthehi Senakan ti. || || Senako thero.
